data.summary: Final project state summary: E221 prototype validated on cached data (36 sub-segments from 25 PSC codes); key enterable sub-segments confirmed (541511, 541519 across IT PSC codes; R425/541330 Engineering Services); tool enhanced with --offline mode and multi-year window; fresh observation on 3 new PSC codes per D083 (all CLOSED); cross-domain evidence: 'fragmented => enterable' inference fails in 5 domains, sub-segment prototype is first to yield actionable differentiation. Evidence labels: observed, source-supported. Remaining next actions: full 25-PSC-code API run, multi-year window validation, fresh observation in new domain, FDA recall hypothesis refinement.
